46878774.title: Tim Cook
46878774.extract: Timothy Donald Cook (born November 1, 1960) is an American business executive who served as the chief executive officer (CEO) of Apple from August 24, 2011, to August 31, 2026, and has been the company's executive chairman since September 1, 2026.
